finding.summary: V6 Local Factor constructs hedge weights from standardized factor loadings, but executable PnL responds to factor shocks in price units. The price-unit exposure also depends on each market's logit-history scale and current p*(1-p) delta.
finding.implication: A pair can be neutral in standardized loading coordinates while retaining material directional common-factor exposure in executable price PnL. This can contaminate residual mean-reversion PnL and partial-fill risk.
finding.repaired_frontier_source: PR #374 scripts/v6_local_factor_v3.py uses the same loading-only hedge ratio

authorized_envelope_interaction.issue: PR #395 lowers the Local Factor executable edge floor from 2 bp to 0.5 bp and raises its max-trade ceiling from $60 to $125 while still invoking the unrepaired scripts/v6_local_factor_intents.py path.
authorized_envelope_interaction.required_order: Repair inference/horizon/TTR and hedge units before applying Local Factor threshold aggression. Other paper sleeves may retain the user-authorized aggressive envelope subject to their own execution gates.

required_next_experiment: Run the repaired leave-one-out/null-preserving/TTR-aware Local Factor on identical chronological panels with three hedge definitions: loading-only, loading*yes_sd, and price-delta p*(1-p)*loading*yes_sd.
Measure realized common-factor beta of the constructed pair before examining alpha.
Then compare candidate survival, turnover, queue-aware joint completion, partial-fill abort/unwind loss, and fill-conditioned executable PnL under 1x/1.5x/2x cost stress.
Do not treat a lower residual factor beta alone as alpha evidence.
